task: Issue #571: the kyverno-policies Argo CD Application ignored whole rule bodies, annotations and validationFailureAction, so real policy edits never auto-synced. Narrow ignoreDifferences to the fields Kyverno defaults.

events.summary: Change only the kyverno-policies Application ignoreDifferences and one explicit validationFailureAction in resources/kyverno-policies.yaml. Deliberately left alone: the same broad list in headlamp-policy and narwhal-platform templates, the global argocd-cm kyverno entry, policy content, live cluster (read-only get and server-side dry-run diff only), Gitea.

Live Application kyverno-policies carried 14 ignore paths (whole rule match/exclude/validate/mutate/generate/verifyImages, validationFailureAction, background, failurePolicy, metadata annotations and labels). Autogen rules are in .status.autogen on Kyverno 1.18, not in spec. kubectl diff --server-side of the repo manifest against the 10 live policies differed only in the argocd tracking-id annotation; a field walk found only Kyverno defaults plus an implicit validationFailureAction Audit on add-default-securitycontext.

D-KYV-IGNORE-NARROW: ignore list reduced to admission, emitWarning, rules[].skipBackgroundRequests, validate.allowExistingViolations, verifyImages useCache and signatureAlgorithm; add-default-securitycontext sets validationFailureAction Audit explicitly.
